title: Native Settings UI Truthfulness, E2E Evidence Integrity & Config Persistence Closure

auditRemediations.E1: S04/S05 unconditional pass removed. S04 download streaming progress verified via auditable CONTROLLED_INJECTION. S05 SQLite compilation verified via REAL Host build.
auditRemediations.E2: S06 cancellation and S07 non-cancellable commit boundary verified with button disabled/busy states, terminal status settlement, and HTTP 409 handling.
auditRemediations.E3: S09 manual DOM injection deleted. Error state rendered truthfully by React component via CONTROLLED_INJECTION.
auditRemediations.E4: S10 duplicate install tested with concurrent requests; verified HTTP 409 and single task.
auditRemediations.E5: S15 cross-process restart persistence verified BEFORE removal with full ECDICT active, proving 770,611 entries, query hit, and 0 re-download.
auditRemediations.E6: S18 unregistration disposer, S19 401/409/500/network error presentation with 0 leak, S20 quarantine UI and action gating verified.
auditRemediations.P1: Page statistics truthfulness: fixed hardcoded 12/12; returns truthful Fixture 7/11 and ECDICT 770,611/57,689; handles missing fields with "暂无统计".
auditRemediations.P2: ConfigForms persistence: handles failure rollback, prevents race conditions, disables switches when not writable, prevents unmounted updates.
